hits.title: Press Release: Cinven, International private equity firm, to acquire Salsify, Inc.
hits.snippet: # Cinven to Acquire Salsify **BOSTON – July 22, 2026** – International private equity firm, Cinven, today announces that it has agreed to acquire Salsify, Inc. (‘the Company’ or ‘Salsify’), a leading cloud-native provider of Product Experience Management (‘PXM’) software solutions. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed. Founded in 2012, Salsify’s global operations span North America, Europe, and Australia, and the Company is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Salsify helps brands manage and share accurate, up-to-date product information with online retailers that sell their products. Brands use Salsify's platform as a single home for their product data, which Salsify autonomously formats and syndicates to match each retailer's specific and frequently changing requirements. Salsify has established a network of more than 2,000 customers, including many of the world’s leading consumer brands, publishing approximately 750 million products across 2,600 commerce destinations for more than 70,000 active users.
